model.name: R20.4: Bug and ChangeRequest are OOP extensions of Requirement with own icons.
model.description: Bug and ChangeRequest become OOP EXTENSIONS (subclasses) of Requirement: ior:class:Bug extends ior:class:Requirement, ior:class:ChangeRequest extends ior:class:Requirement. They trace through the SAME 6-step chain as requirements (Req→UC→Class→Method→Impl→Test) but are distinctly typed. Each is a standard scenario unit in the index with its OWN ICON in rb-object-item (distinct from the Requirement icon). This enables tracing bug-fix chains and change-request chains with full traceability, using the existing Requirement infrastructure.
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "add bug and change request as oop extension to requirement to trace these cases. obviously as std scenarios with own icons on the item view."

intendedChain.useCase: requirement.classifyType — Bug/ChangeRequest render as Requirement subtypes with distinct icons, trace through same chain
intendedChain.class: Requirement (+ Bug extends Requirement, ChangeRequest extends Requirement)
intendedChain.method: icon resolution per ior:class subtype; scenario unit creation with subtype ior
intendedChain.implementation: ior:class:Bug + ior:class:ChangeRequest in class registry; icon-map entry per subtype; rb-object-item resolves icon from ior:class
intendedChain.test: RED: (1) create Bug scenario unit → assert ior=ior:class:Bug, renders with Bug icon (not Requirement icon). (2) create ChangeRequest unit → assert distinct icon. (3) both trace through Req→UC→...→Test chain. Currently FAILS (neither class exists).
